# TasteScoreSelector

The six-step taste scale used when you rate a meal yourself: a row of lg AppButtons labelled −1…5, with the chosen verdict word underneath.

`NomNom.TasteScoreSelector` · Ratings

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.TasteScoreSelector />
```
